description: Move blind-spot capture out of the Git tree with zero new storage tech. New drafts go to ~/.benchbox/finding-drafts/ (outside every worktree; survives worktree churn; per-machine). The existing Markdown schema IS the offline draft format — this satisfies requirement 4 (no new records in Git) and requirement 5 (zero-credential capture) before any database work exists, and it is exactly the local file write review-protocol §4 authorizes. Frontmatter gains OPTIONAL fields only: observed_sha (provenance, not lookup), evidence (list of {path, pattern, note} — grep-pattern-based per the suggested_sweep precedent; line ranges permitted but discouraged since existing records almost never carry line numbers and they rot), urgency/breadth/confidence (set at triage, never required at capture). Required field set is UNCHANGED (id, date, status, finding_kind, review_context) — the adversarial review found mandatory capture-time judgment fields would raise friction and launder guesses into planning order. Filename stem (YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-slug, collision-suffixed) remains the record id and becomes the sync idempotency key in phase 3.
